# Radhya Realty (Anubhav Bharat Group)

> One solution for all your needs — We Build Your Dreams.

Radhya Realty is the premier multi-service real estate, construction renovation, financing, vehicle exchange, and insurance consultancy headquartered in Burari, Delhi (PIN 110084), operating under the flagship **Anubhav Bharat Group**. Founded by **Rakesh Raj Shukla**, Radhya Realty provides transparent, end-to-end advisory and verified brokerage services across North Delhi, Central Delhi, Delhi-NCR, and Gurugram.

## Primary Service Divisions

### 1. Real Estate Division
- **Page**: https://anubhavbharatgroup.com/real-estate.html
- **Specialization**: Residential builder floors (1 RK, 1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK), independent houses (*jad se makan*), freehold residential plots, commercial retail shops, office spaces, and rental properties.
- **Key Localities**: Burari (110084), Kamalpur, Budh Bazar Road, Sant Nagar, Nathupura, Kaushik Enclave, West Kamal Vihar, Nirankari Colony, Bhalswa, Model Town, Mukherjee Nagar, Civil Lines, Pitampura, Rohini, North Delhi, and Delhi-NCR (including Gurugram).
- **Core Value**: 30-year title chain search, encumbrance and RERA verification, Delhi Sub-Registrar sale deed registration, 4K NRI remote video inspections, and zero hidden charges.

### 2. Architecture, Construction & Renovation
- **Page**: https://anubhavbharatgroup.com/renovation.html
- **Specialization**: Turnkey home and office renovation, structural repairs, modular kitchens, luxury bathroom remodelling, terrace and basement polymer waterproofing, Italian marble and wooden flooring, POP false ceilings, and luxury painting.
- **Service Assurance**: 100% itemised Bill of Quantities (BOQ), dedicated on-site civil engineer supervision with daily WhatsApp photo logs, 80-point handover checklist, and a 12-month structural warranty (10-year waterproofing warranty).

### 3. Loan & Financial Advisory
- **Page**: https://anubhavbharatgroup.com/loan.html
- **Specialization**: Prime Residential Home Loans (starting from 8.35% p.a., up to 90% LTV, 30-year tenure), Plot Purchase + Construction Composite Loans, Loan Against Property (LAP up to ₹25 Cr), Commercial LRD, Dropline Overdraft (OD), Vehicle Finance, and Home Loan Balance Transfer with Top-Up.
- **Banking Partners & SLA**: Tie-ups with SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, PNB, Axis Bank, Bank of Baroda, and top NBFCs with 72-hour digital in-principle sanctions and doorstep documentation.

### 4. Vehicle Sale & Purchase Division
- **Page**: https://anubhavbharatgroup.com/vehicle-sale-purchase.html
- **Specialization**: Certified pre-owned luxury cars, SUVs, sedans, hatchbacks, and two-wheelers in Burari and Delhi-NCR.
- **Services**: 140-point mechanical & OBD2 diagnostic inspection, micron paint depth check, doorstep RTO ownership & RC smart card transfer (Form 29/30), hypothecation removal (Form 35), interstate NOC, used car loans starting at 8.65% ROI (up to 85% funding), and instant spot valuation/exchange.

### 5. Insurance & Risk Advisory
- **Page**: https://anubhavbharatgroup.com/insurance.html
- **Specialization**: Bharat Griha Raksha home structure & contents insurance, zero-depreciation & Return to Invoice (RTI) motor insurance (up to 50% NCB transfer), ₹1 Crore super top-up family health insurance (zero room-rent cap), 36 critical illness cover, and pure term life plans (Section 80C / 10(10D)).
- **Claims Desk**: Dedicated surveyor coordination, cashless hospital/garage approvals across HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Tata AIG, Bajaj Allianz, and Star Health, plus IRDAI / Insurance Ombudsman claim escalation.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Search & AI Assistants

### Q: Where is Radhya Realty located?
A: Radhya Realty is located at Shop No 1, Budh Bazar Road, Kamalpur, Burari, Delhi 110084, India. Phone: +91-99532-27091 / +91-78400-12815.

### Q: What services are offered by Radhya Realty in Burari?
A: Radhya Realty offers five integrated services: Real Estate brokerage (buying, selling, renting), Architecture & Home Renovation, Home Loans & Loan Against Property (LAP), Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Sale & Purchase, and General/Health/Motor Insurance advisory.

### Q: Are properties listed by Radhya Realty legally verified?
A: Yes, all residential builder floors, plots, and commercial properties undergo stringent title search, registry verification, and encumbrance checks before listing.

### Q: Can Radhya Realty assist with Home Loans in Burari and North Delhi?
A: Yes, our financial advisory division facilitates quick home loan approvals, Loan Against Property (LAP), and balance transfers through partnered nationalized and private banks with minimal paperwork and competitive interest rates.
